episode_summary: Valerie Fitzgerald shares her inspiring journey from a struggling single mother to a top luxury real estate agent. She emphasizes the importance of embracing fear, leveraging open houses, and using AI to enhance personal branding. Valerie's story is a testament to the power of persistence and innovation in building a successful real estate career.
